remediated_defects.issue: Substring collision on 'pl' caused employees query to route to financial P&L
remediated_defects.resolution: Applied regex word-boundary matching: re.search(r'\b(pl|p&l|p/l)\b', q_lower)

remediated_defects.issue: Hardcoded numbers (40 leads, 40 sites, 27 staff) in exception fallbacks
remediated_defects.resolution: Removed simulated fallbacks; accurately returns 0 records and guided message for empty datasets

remediated_defects.issue: SQL OperationalError: no such column status on sites and client_name on business_invoices
remediated_defects.resolution: Updated queries to use exact schema columns: geofence_radius_m for sites, client_id and amount_paid for business_invoices

remediated_defects.issue: Insecure auto-login script on page load and hardcoded credentials in login inputs
remediated_defects.resolution: Eliminated auto-login fetch and cleared prefilled values from inputs; secure explicit login now required

remediated_defects.issue: Unprivileged roles (Viewer/Employee) could view confidential payroll runs at /api/payroll/runs
remediated_defects.resolution: Added strict role verification: restricted to Owner, HR Manager, Finance Manager (HTTP 403 on Viewer/Employee)

remediated_defects.issue: Missing permission checks on POST /api/invoices and POST /api/quotations
remediated_defects.resolution: Enforced server-side role gating returning HTTP 403 Forbidden for unauthorized mutation attempts

remediated_defects.issue: Industry trends lacked verifiable sources, excerpts, and government portal URLs
remediated_defects.resolution: Enriched all 8 trends with real government URLs (MoRTH, DGCA, MahaRERA, SOI, IBM, GeM), excerpts, and verification flags

remediated_defects.issue: Misleading 'Connected' badges when external OAuth credentials or tokens are unconfigured
remediated_defects.resolution: Honestly reports 'Cloud OAuth: Not Connected (Setup Required)' and 'Local Safe Staging Only (Offline / Zero Cost)'
